title: Duplex Level 1 — vector PDF plan, IFC-aligned coordinates
description: Generates a sophisticated Level 1 floor-plan PDF for the classic Duplex Apartment IFC. Plan is authored in millimetres and loaded with scale=0.001 so the SceneModel lands in metres at the same origin as the Duplex IFC — drop the IFC into the same scene with no extra transform and the two coincide.
